concerns.text: FR‑009 (Makefile orchestration with targets `all`, `evaluate`, `enrich`, `summary`, `clean` and wall‑clock ≤ 6 h) is not listed in any phase of the plan.

FR‑011 (producing `predicted_ppi_<species>.tsv` with columns `protein_id_1`, `protein_id_2`, `correlation`) is not referenced in any phase.
FR‑012 (CLI flag `--seed <int>` for global reproducibility) is missing from the phase‑wise mapping.
FR‑013 (validation of `predicted_ppi_<species>.tsv` against `predicted_edges.schema.yaml`) is not assigned to any phase.
FR‑017 (post‑target verification of output file presence and parsability) is not listed; the plan only mentions a generic “Verification” step in Phase 6 but does not map FR‑017 explicitly.
SC‑002 (at least one GO term with adjusted p‑value < 0.05 per species) is not explicitly referenced; the plan describes GO enrichment and BH correction but does not cite SC‑002.
